title: [v3-4-test] Put the PROD build virtualenv before /usr/python/bin on PATH (#75236)
body:
Backport of #75236 to `v3-4-test`.

Since the PROD image moved to hardened base images, `/usr/python` is a symlink to `/usr`. The build stage's `ENV PATH="/usr/python/bin:$PATH"` therefore puts Debian's pip ahead of the `~/.local` virtualenv. That pip's Python also sees `/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages`, so packages already there — `wheel` from Debian's `python3-wheel` — count as satisfied and never get installed into the virtualenv. The final image runs the virtualenv's Python, which does not see that directory, and `pip check` fails:

```
snowflake-snowpark-python 1.55.2 requires wheel, which is not installed.
```

Seen in "PROD image extra checks / pip-image / Build PROD pip image 3.11" on both `main` and `v3-4-test` (e.g. https://github.com/apache/airflow/actions/runs/39460224771/job/118773527475).

The fix uses the same PATH order the main image already uses (virtualenv first). Reproduced on `ghcr.io/apache/airflow/base/python:3.11.17-debian13-dev`: with the current order `pip check` fails as above, with the virtualenv first it reports no broken requirements.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

files.patch:
@@ -2270,7 +2270,11 @@ ARG USE_CONSTRAINTS_FOR_CONTEXT_DISTRIBUTIONS="false"
 
 # By default PIP installs everything to ~/.local and it's also treated as VIRTUALENV
 ENV VIRTUAL_ENV="${AIRFLOW_USER_HOME_DIR}/.local"
-ENV PATH="/usr/python/bin:$PATH"
+# The virtualenv must come before /usr/python/bin - same as in the main image. In hardened images
+# /usr/python is /usr, so /usr/python/bin holds Debian's pip, whose Python also sees
+# /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages. Installing with it treats packages there (for example wheel) as
+# already satisfied, so they never land in the virtualenv and are missing from the final image.
+ENV PATH="${AIRFLOW_USER_HOME_DIR}/.local/bin:/usr/python/bin:$PATH"
 RUN bash /scripts/docker/install_packaging_tools.sh; bash /scripts/docker/create_prod_venv.sh
 
 COPY --chown=airflow:0 ${AIRFLOW_SOURCES_FROM} ${AIRFLOW_SOURCES_TO}
